football_evidence.question: Can NC State contain Stanford’s explosive runs?
football_evidence.assessment: No material disagreement: EdgeDesk and the line are within 1.3 points.
supporting: When Stanford has the ball (big plays on the ground): Stanford’s offense turns 3.4% of its runs into explosive gains, and NC State’s defense gives up explosive gains on 11.0% of opponent runs (FBS average 6.6%).

When Stanford has the ball (pass protection against the pass rush): Stanford’s offense has allowed a sack on 3.5% of its dropbacks, and NC State’s defense sacks the quarterback on 4.6% of opponent dropbacks (FBS average 5.6%).

When NC State has the ball (big plays through the air): NC State’s offense turns 10.2% of its pass plays into explosive gains, and Stanford’s defense gives up explosive gains on 8.8% of opponent pass plays (FBS average 10.3%).
contradicting: When NC State has the ball (pass protection against the pass rush): NC State’s offense has allowed a sack on 5.1% of its dropbacks, and Stanford’s defense sacks the quarterback on 3.0% of opponent dropbacks (FBS average 5.6%).

When Stanford has the ball (the line of scrimmage on running plays): Stanford’s offense is stopped at or behind the line on 19.8% of its runs, and NC State’s defense stops 22.9% of opponent runs at or behind the line (FBS average 17.4%).
When NC State has the ball (third down): NC State’s offense converts 50.1% of its third downs, and Stanford’s defense allows opponents to convert 44.2% of their third downs (FBS average 39.7%).
When NC State has the ball (the red zone): NC State’s offense succeeds on 43.9% of its red-zone plays, and Stanford’s defense allows success on 55.8% of opponent red-zone plays (FBS average 43.6%).
quarterbacks: Davis Warren has completed 141 of 235 passes (60.0%) for 1,630 yards, 6.9 yards per attempt, 7 touchdowns and 2 interceptions in seven games for Stanford, and has been sacked on 11 of 246 dropbacks.
CJ Bailey has completed 124 of 190 passes (65.3%) for 1,482 yards, 7.8 yards per attempt, 9 touchdowns and 4 interceptions in six games for NC State, and has been sacked on 9 of 199 dropbacks.
